title: Restore completion from authorized persisted targets without replaying mutations
summary: Reconstruct saved handoff status and destinations through a scoped read model; keep unverifiable targets non-actionable.
reusable_steps: Reconstruct saved handoff status and destinations through a scoped read model; keep unverifiable targets non-actionable
expected_outcome: Use this pattern when a successful handoff loses its receipt or destination after reload. Derive completion through GET from saved markers, verifying decision completeness, scenario, target existence, linkage and viewer scope before exposing identifiers. A partial, missing, deleted or unauthorized target remains unavailable rather than reopening confirmation. Use canonical configured destinations and supported scope narrowing. Retire earlier reads before mutations, preserve guards for unresolved mutations, and discard stale session or scope callbacks. Test POST persistence followed by a fresh GET with real isolated readers, then target deletion; exercise reload and Back with request receipts to prove no automatic mutation replay. This does not add server idempotency, repair partial handoffs, or establish authenticated production integration. Verified product commit: https://github.com/famaoai-creator/kyberion/commit/60caa9c048cc87bb41b9f49afa98298fe33a5a9d; all 18 blobs matched the tested manifest. Local 472 tests and PR48 passed; the missing local Playwright runtime remains a CI verification requirement.
